annotations.title: Security deposit rules for a state (and city)

description:
Looks up the security deposit rules (deposits only) for one US state, with a covered city's deposit ordinance (Chicago, San Francisco, Berkeley, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Minneapolis, Saint Paul). Inputs: state (two-letter code); optional city. Returns the deposit return deadline and what starts it, itemization and documentation duties, allowed deductions and depreciation, deposit interest, penalties, the deposit cap and recent changes, with citations. Not for: settling a specific move-out (deposit_settlement_settle does that), evictions, unpaid-rent collection, rent increases or rent control, lease renewal or notice periods, legal advice.
Deterministic and source-cited: the same input gives the same result.

as_of.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD): show the law in force on that day, for a past move-out the day the tenancy ended. Omitted: the current law.

audit.description: Also return the run record and input/result hashes (an audit trail). Default false.

expect_ruleset.description: Optional. The ruleset version you built against, as results carry it in provenance.ruleset_version (e.g. 'sd-2026.11.14'), or its sha256: hash. If the rules have changed since, the call fails (nothing computed, nothing charged) and says what is in force now, so you upgrade on your own schedule. Leave it out to answer under the current rules.

serve_pinned.description: Optional, with expect_ruleset. True asks us to answer under the ruleset version you named even when the rules have changed since, from that version's signed bundle; the result says so in served_from_bundle. We refuse a version older than 12 months, one a later correction or law change replaced for your state, or one we have no bundle for. Default false: the call fails whenever the rules have changed.
